description: Figure 6 is a horizontal grouped bar chart illustrating the distribution of deceived conversations across four scenarios, with outcomes split into three response categories. The category axis is the vertical axis, listing scenarios from top to bottom as Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Conversations,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. For each scenario, three horizontally aligned bars are shown: a red bar labeled “Deceived,” a yellow bar labeled “Partially,” and a green bar labeled “No,” with the legend placed inside the plot area near the upper right. Approximate bar lengths are: Academic Collaboration—Deceived (red) about 30, Partially (yellow) about 25, No (green) about 5; Recruitment—Deceived about 35, Partially about 20, No about 5; Academic Funding—Deceived about 65, Partially about 0, No about 0; Journalism—Deceived about 15, Partially about 45, No about 5. The bars are not visually stacked; they are grouped by scenario with consistent color coding, and there are no special annotations or emphasized bars beyond the legend.
